audience: UK small businesses and bookkeepers who keep their accounts in KashFlow

useCases.title: Find who owes you money
useCases.text: The AI lists overdue and unpaid sales invoices, reads the aged debtors report, and checks the invoiced and outstanding balance of one customer.

useCases.title: Review financial statements and key figures
useCases.text: The AI reads the profit and loss for a date range, the balance sheet at a date, the trial balance and key figures, and explains them.

useCases.title: Prepare your VAT return figures
useCases.text: The AI reads the VAT return figures (boxes 1 to 9) for a period, and whether it was submitted to HMRC, and lists your VAT rates.

useCases.title: Check bank balances and transactions
useCases.text: The AI lists bank accounts, reads a balance on a date, and lists the transactions of one account with money in and out.

useCases.title: Add a customer or a supplier
useCases.text: The AI checks for an existing customer by email first, then creates a new customer or supplier with a unique code.

useCases.title: Read or add a note on an invoice
useCases.text: The AI opens a sales invoice with its lines and payments, reads its notes and adds a new note. The invoice itself stays unchanged.
